description:
FILED s411 (Fable) from the duplicate census (docs/dup-census-worklist-s411.md rows 1, 15, 27, 33, 38): StringInterpolation.pm's parse_array_subscript/parse_hash_subscript/parse_braced_expression/parse_interpolated_variable carry one EXACT 36-line copy (:898-935 vs :1047-1082) and a 6-line brace-depth walk in NINE places (~350 deletable lines) — exactly the low-level scanning docs/interp-scan.md step 3 replaces with scan_one events; Parser2's _fix_interp_token/_interp_canon/_interp_names (8 lines EXACT x3) are consumer 2, and _interp_names is 1.65 s EXCLUSIVE in a 50 s 12-file sample (tools/sub-call-census.pl), so consumer 2 is also the compile-time fix.  #237 remains in_progress for these two halves; #286 (intuit_curly) is NOT folded in (ruled s377).

BAR (interp-scan.md): consumer 2 corpus-diff byte-identical + gate (+ sweep where lib/ shims are reachable); consumer 3 = behaviour changes on divergences 3-7 (each with its probe row vs perl and a guard), corpus-diff flags reachable movement, gen bump.  Standing rule §8: interpolation scanning happens in InterpScan or not at all.  Own session; schedule after Phase B or interleave as the structural filler.
CONSUMER 3 DONE s426 (Opus).  Pl/PExpr/StringInterpolation.pm: 1216 -> 664
lines.  parse_interpolated_variable is a scan_one dispatcher over (sigil,
form, chain); DELETED with their nine brace-depth walks and the 36-line
exact copy the census named: parse_braced_expression,
parse_array_braced_interpolation, parse_array_subscript,
parse_hash_subscript, _parse_subscript_chain, plus the \G name grabs and the
$#/$::/punct-magic branches.  What stayed is the node BUILDING and the
case-mod/literal outer loop, exactly as docs/interp-scan.md step 3 said.

The lowering is three arms, not a table: four leaf-token shapes (WHICH PPI
token is the only open question), one element/slice accessor (exactly one
bracket group on a NAME), and â for every deref base, braced EXPRESSION,
second group or explicit arrow â the reference's own SOURCE TEXT through the
ordinary expression pipeline, the move _parse_postfix_deref and consumer 1's
_compile_ref_text_form already made.  Divergences 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 of the
docs/interp-scan.md table are CLOSED by that; #420 and #422.1 with them.

MEASURED: corpus-diff 0 of 111 files from the port itself (the six files
that moved are the #420 emitter half, a separate fix in Pl/ExprToCL.pm).

CONSUMER 2 (the Parser2 rename machinery: _fix_interp_token / _interp_canon
/ _interp_names / _interp_fixer, %canon_pat, VarAnnotator's quote scans)
IS STILL OPEN â and it is the compile-time half (_interp_names was 1.65 s
EXCLUSIVE in a 50 s 12-file sample).  #237 stays in_progress for it.
